title: test(ci-docs): pin the Workflow Inventory table, which the inventory test could not see
body:
Fixes #8726

## The defect

The `ci-cd-pipeline.md — workflow inventory` block built its `documented` set from lines matching `/^#{1,6}\s/` — markdown **headings only** — so the "Workflow Inventory" table on that page was read by nothing at all. A workflow satisfied *"gives every workflow in .github/workflows/ its own section"* purely by having a heading somewhere on the page, while its table row could be absent, duplicated, or say the opposite of the truth.

The sharpest part: the block's own failure message tells a contributor to add a heading **"and a row in the 'Workflow Inventory' table."** That last clause was advice no assertion enforced. It is enforced now, so the message and the assertions agree.

## ⭐ What a row must assert — the decision, and why

A row must:

1. **exist** for every non-exempt workflow in `.github/workflows/`, and name no workflow that is not there (both directions);
2. **appear exactly once**;
3. **make no claim about a YAML property that the workflow it names does not declare** — implemented for the two keys the table's own cells invoke, `continue-on-error` and `merge_group`.

⛔ **Deliberately not pinned: whether the free prose of `Runs on` and `Blocks a PR?` is correct.** Those cells carry real nuance ("every job but the two coverage-lane jobs", "ESLint **errors** only") that no derivation reproduces, and the honest source for a blocking answer is the repository's required-context set, which lives in GitHub's settings and not in this tree.

Deriving "Blocks a PR?" from a `merge_group` trigger was considered and **rejected as a false derivation in the direction that matters**: `hook-selftests.yml` declares no `merge_group` and the page rightly answers **Yes**. Pinning more than the page can honestly promise is how a pin becomes the next card, so (3) checks only the narrow, mechanical thing — a named YAML key the row itself invokes — the same discipline the structural-claims machinery already applies to the page's bullet.

**Why existence alone is not enough.** The page asserts the `continue-on-error` claim about the Live E2E lane in its structural-claims bullet, and #8084 took the property off the job. So the page could carry a *contradiction with itself* — a corrected bullet beside an uncorrected row — and stay green. That is what (3) closes.

## ⭐ Acceptance evidence — the ablations, not the green suite

The suite is green today *with the defect present*, so a passing run proves nothing here. Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor counts plus a changed `git hash-object` blob) and each restore proven by **state** — blob equality against the `HEAD` blob plus an empty `git diff HEAD` — never by an exit code. Re-taken on the merged head `9772e6a4`.

| ablation | mutation | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | `live-e2e.yml`'s trailing cell rewritten back to the stale `continue-on-error` wording #8692 had just removed | 🟢 74 passed | 🔴 1 failed \| 78 passed — `makes no continue-on-error claim the workflow YAML does not carry` |
| **B** | `lockfile-integrity.yml`'s inventory row deleted outright, its `##` section kept | 🟢 74 passed | 🔴 1 failed \| 78 passed — `gives every workflow … a row in the inventory table — in both directions` |
| **C** | a `labeler.yml` row duplicated | — | 🔴 1 failed \| 78 passed — `names each workflow in exactly one inventory row` |

Each failed in its *intended* test with its intended diagnostic, not by accident.

## The table is truthful today — measured, not assumed

37 rows, 37 workflows on disk, 37 headings; no missing row, no phantom row, no duplicate. **No edit to `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` was needed or made** — this PR changes exactly one file.

## No third table reader

As instructed, the markdown table reader is **lifted to module scope** rather than copied a third time. Two blocks had already grown a byte-identical copy of the same loop (skip the separator row, stop at the first non-row line); both now call the shared `markdownTableRows`, verified behaviour-preserving by an unchanged 74/74 before the new pins were added. Callers keep their own header assertion — each has a different thing to say about a table that has gone missing.

## Boundaries honoured

- ⛔ **No assertion weakened or removed.** Test count **74 → 79**; the file had just gained pins today and this does not reduce them.
- ⛔ **#8420's surface untouched** — the per-section command-parity assertions and their classification comment are not in this diff.
- ⛔ No test skipped, disabled or quarantined. ⛔ `content/docs/releases/` untouched.
- One comment elsewhere in the file said the inventory block "matches filenames in headings"; that clause is now incomplete, so it reads "in headings and in the inventory table's first column". Its actual claim — that the block cannot see a false sentence *inside* a documented section — is unchanged and still true.

## Verification

- `vitest run scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` — **79 passed**, exit 0 on the merged head.
- `vitest run --project unit scripts/__tests__` — **139 files, 4125 passed**, 2 skipped, exit 0. (Other tests read this file by name; all green.)
- `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit` — exit 0, and `--listFiles` confirms it genuinely reads the changed file rather than excluding it.
- `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` — `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 7256 tracked text file(s))`; plus a direct control-byte scan of the changed file, zero hits.
- `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` — `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test <the changed file>` — `NOT GOVERNED`.
- **Changeset gate**, printed verbatim: `1 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a manifest whose published contract moved, 0 under a package changesets ignores, 0 changeset(s) added.` / `✅  No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` — exit 0, so none was added.
- ESLint on the changed file: **0 errors, 0 warnings**. Type-aware linting is not enabled in the flat config, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

`origin/main` was merged before opening this PR, as the dispatch ordered; it touched neither this test file, the page, nor `.github/workflows/`, and every reading above was re-taken afterwards.
